description: Ania Studio makes YouTube videos (16:9) and Shorts/Reels (9:16) about the user’s app or any channel topic (lessons, faith, drawing…), with their own images and clips. The presenter is the user’s Ania avatar, the user themself (their own recording, background removed, their own voice) or nobody (narration + content only). Narration in pt-BR or en-US. A project is the series/channel (brand, presenter, voice, format); each episode is one video with an Ania Script (titulo + cenas). Creates a project (the series or channel). Presenter (apresentador): "avatar" with avatar_id from the user’s own library (my_avatars: created, bought or free); "video" = the user records themself reading the script (phone/webcam, any background), you upload each clip with studio_enviar_midia and the render removes the background and uses their own voice (audio_apresentador "gravacao", default) or keeps an Ania voice and uses the clip as image only ("tts"); "nenhum" (default without avatar_id) = no one on screen, the voice narrates over images/clips/cards (layouts foco-total / v-cheia). Voice from studio_listar_vozes. Use one project per format: formato "9:16" for Shorts (vertical layouts v-*), "16:9" (default) for regular videos. Same price per minute in every mode. Free; agree on name, colour, presenter, voice and format with the user first.

apresentador.description: Who appears: 'avatar' (needs avatar_id), 'video' (the user’s own recording, background removed) or 'nenhum' (narration only). Default: 'avatar' with avatar_id, else 'nenhum'.

apresentador_nome.description: Presenter's name (defaults to the app name).

audio_apresentador.description: Presenter 'video' only: 'gravacao' (default) = the voice of the user’s recordings, one clip per scene (cenas[].gravacao); 'tts' = the chosen voice narrates and video_apresentador is image only (looped).

descricao.description: What the channel/app is about (optional, not spoken).

formato.description: Video shape: '16:9' (YouTube, default) or '9:16' (Shorts/Reels/TikTok: 20–45 s, layouts v-gancho, v-tela, v-cheia, v-cta, v-dupla).

language.description: The user's language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'). Replies and prices follow it.

nome.description: App / series name shown in the vignette.

slogan.description: One-line slogan for the opening vignette (optional).

slug.description: Short id for the project, kebab-case (e.g. 'my-app').

url_app.description: https URL of the app, when the series is about one (optional).

video_apresentador.description: Presenter 'video': the clip of the user ('midia/apresentador.mp4' by default) — the image with 'tts', or the whole recording of a one-scene video with 'gravacao'.

voz.description: Voice id from studio_listar_vozes (default 'kokoro-alex'), including the user's own 'minha-<id>' voices. en-US: kokoro-heart, kokoro-michael, azure-andrew, azure-ava. With a recorded presenter it is only the fallback.
